messages:
maya: Quick check — planning to open the structured-output toggle (structured_output_v2) to 10% canary tomorrow. Who's ok with client SDK falling back to compat_mode=legacy for now? We hit some strict-parser errors yesterday. ping @keith
nick: Agree with 10% canary. Can we scope to region=eu for this wave? Less traffic there.
keith: I saw the parser errors. I'll push a small fix for tolerant parsing in the JS SDK today. That will keep legacy payloads working. Should not change wire contract.
olivia: FYI: New rollout guardrail idea — if 5xx rate or core-metric regression > 2x baseline in first 30m, auto-disable flag. We can hook that into the rollout controller.
maya: +1 on guardrail. Can you add rule? Also we need a clear fallback in the API: if client requests function_calling but gets structured output disabled, return {"call":null, "text":...}
keith: ack. I'll update SDK to treat missing function_schema as no-op and surface a warning log instead of throwing.
nick: region-scoped canary makes sense. ops: do we have dedicated capacity in eu tomorrow? cc @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: scheduled: reserved pool in eu for 3/24 02:00-08:00 UTC. Alert hook: #incidents if disable trigger fires.
maya: Perf question — with structured_output_v2 on, token cost changed? Redwood Optimize suggested a quantization profile. Any objections to enabling small batching tweak (batching_policy.max_batch_tokens=1024)?
keith: batching tweak ok. SDK change + tolerant parser + log warning; will open PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321
olivia: I'll add the guardrail rule to rollout config. Draft config snippet:
```
flag: structured_output_v2
audience: { region: eu, percentage: 10 }
compatibility: legacy
guardrails:
  - metric: error_rate
    window: 30m
    threshold: 2.0
    action: disable
```
maya: Perfect. Who's owning the rollout runbook? Need steps for rollback, communication, and post-mortem triggers.
nick: I can own the runbook and do the canary window. Will coordinate with oncall. Share doc in #eng-runbooks after PRs merged.
keith: PR opened. cc maya for review.
maya: reviewing now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
